name: Two-target: head-on plus crossing from starboard
own_ship_role: mutual with TS1 / give-way to TS2
description: TS1 is head-on; TS2 crosses from own-ship's starboard bow at the same time. Both encounters call for a starboard alteration, testing whether a single coherent manoeuvre satisfies both.
pass_criteria: Own-ship alters to starboard (satisfying both Rule 14 and Rule 15/16 simultaneously).
Minimum CPA to BOTH targets stays above the safe-distance threshold.
